claim: Actions pinned to commit SHAs fetched live from the GitHub API; windows-latest CI leg added so the cp1252 class is covered by environment.
A mechanical Stop-hook auto-checkpoint was rejected by design: distillates are model-authored and an honest one cannot be generated by a hook.
Fail-closed topology: a broken gold ladder blocks ALL deploys until repaired, not just the suspect record - confirmed as correct posture by the code reviewer.
Versioning cadence per the human: y-incremental (x.x.y) bumps from here; every bump still syncs the four lint-enforced carriers.
The lease guards chain APPEND only: prune funnels through the next guarded checkpoint and merge operates where the lease already failed - guarding them is ceremony without protection.
A flaky test is a defect signal, not noise: the doctrine's no-retry-until-green rule is what surfaced the v0.6.2 escape.
No more Co-Authored-By trailers in this repo's commits (operator rule); authorship travels in docs/metrics/enrichment.json instead.
Startup roles are all main-thread: everything they produce points outward and external sends belong to the human - the same reasoning that keeps Release Manager out of subagents.
Deliberate non-roles recorded in the standard: no head-of-compliance above compliance-officer, no separate cybersecurity role - a title without distinct authority is ceremony.

The repo IS the cue - no wake-word; 'doctrine: <task>' forces engagement anywhere the law is installed, and only the human bypasses, announced as [DOCTRINE BYPASSED - human instruction], never silent.

AGPL-3.0 disposition recorded per dependency policy: MAPLE is never vendored and never imported by doctrineos (stdlib-only stays); document + protocol contract only; consumers opting in flag 'Workforce runtime: maple' in their brief.

G5 security review (fresh subagent) caught a real MAJOR: --verify ran the TARGET's tool files, but copy_file skips different-content files without --force, so a stale/hostile doctrine_verify.py would run and print a false 'gates green'. Fixed; the gate loop worked.
